## Purpose

Describe the Azure Databricks phase and outcome this change supports.

## Safety and cost

- [ ] Changes stay inside the approved `Databricks` resource group and workspace.
- [ ] No credential, personal identifier, or raw Azure resource ID is committed.
- [ ] New or changed cloud resources list SKU, region, owner, and estimated cost.
- [ ] Paid resources remain disabled unless the approved budget gate is recorded.

## Validation

- [ ] Phase-specific tests pass locally.
- [ ] Migration asset hashes and data contracts still reconcile.
- [ ] Documentation and rollback notes are updated where applicable.
